scopes.label: Editor
scopes.reason: Everything under src/common/editor/ that is not controller, command or engine code: models, workers, storage, effects and import/export, where an unexercised branch corrupts a user's project. The authenticated browser-source reporting correction rebases lines 98% to 95% (measured 96.743900%, 419379/433494). The complete eleven-profile Node/Chromium union from Quality run 40245790206 at 3da40585a98c was replayed without changing its recorded V8 counters or mappings. The old multi-source file-URL exclusion bypassed zero-count assignments before exporting default-covered lines, and omitted source declarations distorted function percentages. Source-path normalization now applies those counts and includes the authenticated declarations. This is a global measurement-baseline correction, retaining the established one-percentage-point ratchet headroom; it changes no shard, source scope, test, or Lightscaper threshold.
